Review the gathered public evidence below and propose concise evidence-backed OSS Security KB updates for Maven org.springframework:spring-web. Do not fabricate findings. Keep scope package-level; note config-dependent reachability. Suggest vulnerability classes, status notes, and next review targets. Evidence:
- GHSA-2rmj-mq67-h97g / CVE-2024-38809: Spring Framework DoS via conditional HTTP request fixed: 5.3.38, 6.0.23, 6.1.12 refs: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-38809; https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/33372; https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/commit/582bfccbb72e5c8959a0b472d1dc7d03a20520f3; https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/commit/8d16a50907c11f7e6b407d878a26e84eba08a533
